mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.role, u.center_id AS centerId, c.name AS centerName, u.name, u.email, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.status FROM users u JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=u.center_id WHERE u.email = LOWER(#{email}) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.role, u.center_id AS centerId, c.name AS centerName, u.name, u.email, u.status, sp.student_id AS studentId FROM users u JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=u.center_id LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT student_id FROM student_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(role, center_id, name, email, password_hash, age, terms_agreed) VALUES(#{role}, #{centerId}, #{name}, LOWER(#{email}), #{passwordHash}, #{age}, #{termsAgreed})
INSERT INTO student_profiles(user_id, center_id, name, age) VALUES(#{userId}, #{centerId}, #{name}, #{age})
INSERT INTO refresh_tokens(user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{hash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id AS userId, u.role FROM refresh_tokens r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.token_hash = #{hash} AND r.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE token_hash = #{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT email FROM users WHERE name=#{name} AND center_id=#{centerId} AND role=#{role} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 5
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash=#{passwordHash} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
